scientific_integrity: The infinite field range is proved by a character-sum bound, and exactly fifteen smaller nonprime fields are exhaustively checked. This is a same-model review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only nonprime finite fields of characteristic at least five; counts whether each quadratic-character word occurs and lists all missing words, but does not give every positive fiber multiplicity. The finite component has an exhaustive source checker. An earlier general trace formula or an unindexed classification may affect priority; independent mathematical and literature audits have not been performed.
title: Complete five-word quadratic-character universality in nonprime finite fields
